task.title: Charge Your Pulse Bottle
task.shortdesc: Charge your bottle fully before using it for the first time.

context.p: A full charge takes approximately 90 minutes and powers the display for up to two weeks.

step.cmd: Plug the USB-C cable into the charging port on the base of the bottle.
Connect the other end of the cable to any USB power source.
Wait until the display ring turns solid white, which indicates a full charge.

taskbody.result: Your bottle is charged and ready to pair with the Pulse app.
